title: SWE-Perf: Can Language Models Optimize Code Performance on Real-World Repositories?
authors_zh: Xinyi He, Qian Liu, Mingzhe Du, Lin Yan, Zhijie Fan, Yiming Huang, Zejian Yuan, Zejun Ma
paper_type_zh: 可程序验证的仓库级性能优化基准
best_for_zh: 需要以正确性测试和可复现运行时共同评测代码智能体的研究者。
one_line: SWE-Perf evaluates repository-level performance patches on 140 real pull-request tasks using executable correctness tests and runtime measurements.
SWE-Perf 从真实性能优化 PR 构建 140 个仓库级任务，并以正确性测试和运行时间共同验证补丁。
why: It evaluates a patch through executable behavior and measured runtime rather than a text-only judgment.
inclusion_reason: Each record couples a repository modification with executable tests and a measured terminal performance outcome.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Coding-agent benchmarks mainly check whether functionality is repaired and rarely measure whether a patch makes production code faster. Function-level kernel benchmarks reveal target locations and omit bottleneck localization, relevant-test selection, and behavior preservation in large repositories. A model can produce correct but slower code, which ordinary Pass@1 does not distinguish.

SWE-Perf constructs 140 tasks from real performance-improving pull requests. Each provides a complete repository, target functions or a realistic problem statement, performance-related tests, an expert patch, and an executable environment. Agent patches first pass correctness checks and then have before–after runtime measured. The benchmark uses real expert optimizations as references for repository-level performance engineering.

代码 agent benchmark 主要检查功能是否修复，很少测量补丁是否真正加速生产代码；函数级 kernel benchmark 又给出明确目标位置，省略在大型仓库中定位性能瓶颈、选择相关测试和保持行为不变的过程。模型可能生成正确但更慢的代码，现有 Pass@1 无法区分。

SWE-Perf 从真实开源仓库的性能优化 PR 构建 140 个任务。每题给出完整代码库、目标函数或现实化问题描述、性能相关测试、专家补丁和可执行环境；agent 生成 patch 后先过正确性检查，再比较修改前后的运行时间。该 benchmark 用真实专家优化作为上限，评测 repository-level performance engineering。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is the first systematic benchmark for real repository performance optimization. From 102,241 pull requests across nine Python repositories, the authors filter 140 stable instances. Records include base and head commits, performance tests, target functions, oracle and realistic problem descriptions, expert patches, baseline and expert runtimes, environment versions, and fields such as human_performance. The contract requires both functional tests and improved runtime, distinguishing it from correctness-only SWE-bench. The Hugging Face release has no separate training split and defaults entirely to test, supporting performance-agent evaluation, bottleneck localization, and joint correctness–efficiency rewards.

核心贡献是首个系统化的真实仓库性能优化 benchmark。作者从 9 个 Python 仓库的 102,241 个 PR 逐步筛到 140 个稳定实例；每条记录含 base/head commit、性能测试、目标函数、oracle 与 realistic 问题描述、专家 patch、基线/专家运行时间、环境版本及 human_performance 等字段。验证契约同时要求功能测试通过和性能测试运行时间下降，因而区别于只判正确性的 SWE-bench。数据公开于 Hugging Face，无单独 train split，默认全部作为 test；可用于性能 agent 评测、瓶颈定位研究和 correctness–efficiency 双 reward 设计。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect performance pull requests: Mine 102,241 pull requests from nine popular Python repositories and use keywords and code changes to identify likely performance improvements.
  1. Replay before and after versions: Run base and head versions in reproducible environments, locate relevant performance tests and modified functions, and remove candidates that fail installation, have unstable tests, or show no real speedup.
  1. Confirm stable improvements: Repeat performance tests and use statistical filtering to remove noise and accidental fluctuations. Retain tasks whose expert patch reliably accelerates code without breaking functional tests.
  1. Create evaluation inputs: Store full repositories, target functions, oracle or realistic descriptions, performance and correctness tests, and expert baselines. Runtime is compared only after an agent patch passes functionality. Reproduction requires fixed hardware, CPU load, repetitions, Python and dependency versions, and images.

1. 收集性能 PR： 从 9 个热门 Python 仓库抓取 102,241 个 PR，用关键词和修改内容筛选可能提升速度的候选。
  1. 重放前后版本： 在可复现环境中分别运行 base 与 head，定位与 PR 相关的性能测试和修改函数，排除无法安装、测试不稳定或无真实加速的候选。
  1. 确认稳定提升： 多次执行性能测试，以统计规则过滤噪声和偶然波动；保留专家 patch 能稳定加速且不破坏功能测试的任务。
  1. 生成评测输入： 保存完整仓库、目标函数、oracle/realistic 描述、性能和正确性测试及专家基线。agent patch 通过功能测试后计算相对运行时间。复现需固定硬件、CPU 负载、重复次数、Python/依赖版本和镜像。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors compare file-level and repository-level methods such as Agentless and OpenHands over the same 140 environments. The best AI system still trails expert patches by about 8.59 percentage points, and tasks with longer runtimes or larger expert speedups are harder. Error analysis suggests that models may edit related code yet lack architectural performance reasoning. All 140 tasks come from real pull requests and repeated measurements, supporting realism. Results remain sensitive to whether target functions are provided, hardware noise, and agent scaffolds. Expert patches are not necessarily theoretical optima, so the evidence shows a gap to the engineers who authored those pull requests rather than an absolute human ceiling.

作者使用 Agentless、OpenHands 等 file-level 与 repository-level 方法，在同一 140 题环境中比较多种模型。最佳 AI 系统与专家 patch 之间仍有约 8.59 个百分点的性能差距，且运行时间更长、专家加速幅度更大的任务更难；错误分析显示模型常能改到相关代码却缺乏架构级性能推理。140 题均由真实 PR 和重复运行筛出，支持 benchmark 的现实性。结果仍受目标函数是否提供、硬件噪声和 agent scaffold 影响；专家 patch 也不一定是理论最优，因此证据说明“当前模型明显落后于提交该 PR 的工程师”，不能定义绝对人类上限。

title: Novelty
新意
html: SWE-bench defines success as failing tests becoming passing, while KernelBench measures correctness and speed for isolated GPU kernels. SWE-Perf retains real performance pull requests, relevant tests, and expert runtimes within full repositories and requires agents to preserve functionality while reducing runtime. It also offers oracle target-function and realistic problem-statement settings, separating optimization with known localization from autonomous localization. The work does not propose a new optimization algorithm; it converts real repository performance patches into replayable tasks and makes runtime improvement part of the formal verifier contract.

SWE-bench 以失败测试转为通过为成功，KernelBench 则评估孤立 GPU kernel 的正确性与速度。SWE-Perf 的变化是在完整仓库中保留真实性能 PR、相关测试和专家运行时间，要求 agent 同时保持正确性并缩短运行时间；还提供 oracle target function 与 realistic problem statement 两种输入，以区分已知定位和自主定位。它没有提出新的优化算法，而是把真实 repository performance patch 转成可重放评测对象，并把执行时间提升正式纳入 verifier contract。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Performance noise: Runtime depends on CPUs, caches, concurrent load, warmup, and dependency implementations, making small differences unstable. Evaluation must fix hardware and resources, repeat runs, and report uncertainty rather than one wall-clock measurement.
  1. Scale and ecosystem: The 140 tasks come from only nine Python repositories and cover limited optimization and hardware types. They do not represent C++, GPUs, distributed systems, memory, or energy optimization.
  1. Target leakage and oracle setting: Providing target functions greatly simplifies localization, while realistic descriptions may be back-translated from pull requests and contain clues. The dataset is entirely a test split, so repeated tuning contaminates it. Oracle and realistic settings should be reported separately, and the 140 tasks should not be used for training.

1. 性能噪声： 运行时间受 CPU、缓存、并行任务、热身和依赖实现影响，微小差异可能不可复现。评测必须固定硬件与资源，重复运行并报告置信区间，而非一次 wall-clock。
  1. 数据规模与生态： 140 题仅来自 9 个 Python 仓库，性能优化类型和硬件有限；不能代表 C++、GPU、分布式系统或内存/能耗优化。
  1. 目标泄漏与 oracle： 提供 target functions 会显著简化定位，realistic 描述又可能从 PR 回译并带线索；数据全部是 test split，反复调参会污染 benchmark。应分开报告两种设置，并避免用 140 题训练。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate performance agents: Run agents on fixed hardware and containers, verify functionality first, and measure performance repeatedly. Report success, speedup, regressions, expert-relative gaps, and separate oracle and realistic inputs.
  1. Study localization: Use patch_functions, test_functions, and modified files to train or evaluate bottleneck retrieval, but accept results only when they preserve behavior and yield stable speedups.
  1. Design dual-objective rewards: Make correctness a hard gate and performance improvement a continuous reward, with statistical thresholds for timeouts, noise, and tiny gains. Training requires separately mined data; the public test set should not be used directly for SFT or RL.

1. 性能 agent 评测： 在固定硬件与容器上运行 agent，先验证功能，再多次测量性能；报告成功率、加速比、回归率和相对专家差距，并区分 oracle/realistic 输入。
  1. 定位研究： 使用 patch_functions、test_functions 和真实修改文件训练或评测 bottleneck retrieval，但最终必须以未破坏功能且稳定加速验收。
  1. 双目标 reward： 将正确性作为硬门槛，性能改善作为连续 reward；对超时、噪声和微小加速设置统计阈值。若研究要训练模型，应另行挖掘数据，不能在公开 test 上直接 SFT 或 RL。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SWE-Perf filters 140 real repository optimization tasks from 102,241 pull requests and verifies both correctness and runtime.
  1. Method takeaway: Performance-PR filtering, before–after replay, repeated timing, stable-speedup checks, and oracle versus realistic inputs form the pipeline.
  1. Data takeaway: Each task includes commits, tests, target functions, descriptions, expert patches, runtimes, and environments; there is no train split and all data is evaluation.
  1. Evidence anchor: The best AI remains about 8.59 points behind experts, with longer workloads and larger expert gains proving harder and exposing weak architectural reasoning.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits joint correctness–performance evaluation. Timing noise and test contamination require fixed hardware and no benchmark training.

1. 一句话定位： SWE-Perf 从 102,241 个 PR 筛出 140 个真实仓库性能优化任务，同时验证正确性和运行时间。
  1. 方法抓手： 性能 PR 筛选、前后版本重放、重复计时、稳定加速检查和 oracle/realistic 输入构成流程。
  1. 数据抓手： 每条含 commit、测试、目标函数、描述、专家 patch、运行时间与环境；无 train split，默认全部评测。
  1. 证据锚点： 最佳 AI 与专家仍差约 8.59 点，长运行和高专家加速任务更难，模型缺乏架构级推理。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 correctness–performance 双目标评测；最大风险是计时噪声和 test 污染，必须固定硬件并禁止训练。
